findings: Multi-selection drag cost scales linearly with selection size: 1,000 simultaneously dragged objects cost about 239 ms per drag frame in the engine alone, far outside the 16.7 ms frame budget. Phase 1B never claimed a large-selection drag budget; this is recorded as a measured limit, not a defect.

A rubber band started on a Frame's own background previously also selected that Frame, because the rectangle tool creates shapes as siblings of the Frame. The band now excludes the container it was drawn on (exclude_ids); covered by a new EngineHost test.
